basis: Parent directly opened the unmodified returned original. Visible structure/contact only; no edge skill, performance or successful phase transition is inferred.

component_observations.evidence: White boot upper, a distinct brown sole and raised brown heel sit above the metal blade mount.
The front-sole and heel mounting portions connect visibly to one continuous narrow metal runner below the boot.
The support runner’s lower edge meets the ice while the boot sole stays elevated above that edge; contact, mount and heel are visible together.

reference_appearance: Dark bob/fringe, dark eyes and visible facial proportions correspond to the reference; not identity authentication.
minor_authored_variation: Boot upper is white but sole/heel are brown. U03 imposes no sole color, so this does not invalidate its source groups.
